verdict.rationale: Reclaim 2.0's Schedule Assistant "highlights what needs attention and suggests what to do next." A natural-language AI chat assistant helps plan, prioritize and optimize the schedule, and changes can be previewed before deploying. Separately, the product analyzes your time across meetings, tasks and work-life balance metrics, with auto-categorized stats on where time goes. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what insights and suggestions the assistant actually generates, and independent hands-on corroboration of the AI suggestion and insight quality.
